messages:
maria-support: FYI customer (Cust-228) reporting embeddings length changed after we pinned to model x-embed-v2. They see 1536 -> 1024 vectors.
raj-ml: can you paste the API request and the response shape?
maria-support: pasted below. request: `POST /v1/embeddings model=x-embed-v2 input=["hello"]`
cust-ops: here's the response we receive locally: `{"data":[{"embedding":[...1536 numbers...] , "index":0}]}` (we see 1536), then after the pinned rollout we got `{"data":[{"embedding":[...1024 numbers...] , "index":0}]}`
elaine-ops: deploy-bot just posted a pinned release 2024-11-21T10:02Z -> tag: x-embed-v2@locked-20241121 :deploy:
deploy-bot: pinned deploy completed on infra-pool-4 in us-east-1 (request id r-9f8a7c)
raj-ml: likely causes: model binary swapped with a quantized variant or alias mapping to a different architecture. Did customer pin a variant or we force-fallback?
maria-support: customer says they pinned the model id they got from the Console UI. They did not change encoding on their side. No errors in API, just different length.
raj-ml: ask for full response headers and model metadata from /v1/models/x-embed-v2/describe (we include model_id and dims). Also ask for batch vs single request. Batching can trigger fallback variant if not compatible.
maria-support: sent instructions. Customer sent back headers: `x-redwood-model: x-embed-v2`, `x-redwood-model-variant: x-embed-v2-quant128`, `x-request-id: r-9f8a7c`
raj-ml: aha — model-variant header shows quantized variant. That variant emits 1024 dim outputs (we keep a legacy quantized fingerprint that uses smaller head). We should have rejected compatibility or kept shape stable.
elaine-ops: how did the pinned lock pick up the quantized variant? Ops rollout record shows the alias mapping for x-embed-v2 pointed to x-embed-v2-quant128 for pool infra-pool-4 after autoscale substitution. I’ll open an infra ticket.
maria-support: customer asked for rollback to previous shape; they want a timeline and repro steps.
raj-ml: short-term: recommend one of: 1) return to previous variant by unpinning or switching to x-embed-v2@sha256:<old> 2) provide a compatibility adapter that pads/truncates vectors — but that is risky for downstream semantics 3) re-run offload to ensure alias points to canonical dense variant.
elaine-ops: rolling back alias for cust-228 -> doing a canary swap to x-embed-v2@sha256:aa11bb (previous) on their reserved pool. Will monitor.
maria-support: shared workaround with customer: use the model metadata header to assert vec length on client and fail early. They want an SLA ETA.
raj-ml: follow-up: we should add a server-side validation preventing variant aliases from changing output dimension for pinned customers. I’ll file a change request and add a regression test.
maria-support: customer confirmed they see 1536 again after rollback. Closing with them after 24h observation. :thumbsup:
elaine-ops: infra ticket IT-5543 created, assigns: elaine-ops, note: investigate alias substitution on autoscale fallback.
maria-support: tagging docs/announcements for pinned-model stability note.
raj-ml: thanks everyone. Keep me posted if any deviations.
